title: writable-root-args
description: A runtime's template for being handed one writable root: a non-empty list of strings with exactly one element equal to the literal {path}, and no other element containing {path}. The runner appends it after the runtime's args only for a node in a linked worktree, replacing that element with the absolute common git directory as one argv element, never shell-evaluated or split. runtimes@v0 entries and local@v0's runtime block both reference this part, so the two constraints are one.
